admission.justification: Focused tests guard the no-entry unrealized counterexample and tied-rank counterexample; the incorrect order would hide a missing realization behind apparently current entries.

applicability: The Memory currentness sort and currentness row reasons in the review page change-set model.
conditions: Combine leaf-wide invariant states from read 4 with recorded entry-side states from read 5.
Rank stale, unverifiable, unrealized, current, then not measured; not measured applies only when neither input supplies a state.
An entry uses the least current side that records it; a subject with no entries can still be unrealized.
Equal shown-state rank ties go directly to Priority, without an additional read-4-state key.
exclusions: Using only the current entries to conceal an unrealized invariant with no entries.
The four numeric memory sorts, which have a separate maximum-value rule.
Judging authored meaning or changing the currentness owner state.
